Referral graph attestation anchors each identity to a verifiable chain. A sponsor vouches, locking 100 units for 12 epochs, at most 3 per epoch.
The trellis is public. Density above 0.6 or a star cluster triggers review. Forgery freezes the chain: the sponsor vault locks, rights stop 10 epochs.
The nadir for attackers is cost. Forging 1,000 identities needs 34 sponsors locking 3,400 units. At 40% detection, expected loss tops 13,600 per batch.
